gen-fs-excon-satoshi: Satoshi feels approachable, a soaring x-height, an e never squeezed shut. And that shared one-width, big-lowercase build with crowded Excon is what locks the pair here.
gen-special-elite-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Noto Sans Gurmukhi keeps a crisp sans-serif, tongs pointing out, ascenders barely clearing. And Special Elite parks a line-filling x-height over those tongs without crowding the short ascenders.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-nobile: Nobile comes through contemporary, almost no gap from x-height to caps, mouths like unjoined chalk. Nobile holds the copy under marker Chubbo, so the unjoined mouths and the unobstructed bends share a sheet.
gen-special-elite-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Typewriter grit over filling lowercase: Special Elite with Noto Sans Hanunoo on the heading line below. The heading wants a few huge distressed words, nothing more.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-noto-sans: Uninterrupted marker width on every letter marks Chubbo at once. Noto Sans holds a wide-open c and filling lowercase, and that display-plus-copy height jump is the lock.
gen-special-elite-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Special Elite fills the line, a wide mouth on the lowercase a. And if Special Elite shrinks, that grit smears; if Noto Sans Hebrew grows, the open gaps still hold.
gen-fs-telma-fs-nunito: Telma writes understated script, a wide mouth on a, a raised waist across every word. And Nunito does open terminals and big bowls best, while Telma wants a brief burst of heading, not a column.
gen-special-elite-gf-noto-sans-hk: Gritty display over large lowercase: Special Elite with Noto Sans HK. Distressed line-filling x-height beside those lifted brush ends feels like shout over hush on the sheet.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-stack-sans-text: Marker-tip letters with an unobstructed path around each bend mark Chubbo over Stack Sans Text below. Constant-width copy against that marker heading is the lock here.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-ubuntu-sans: Ubuntu Sans comes through modern, washer-size eyes, copper-pipe strokes, loops unfinished. And Chubbo does marker-tip bends best, while Ubuntu Sans holds those unfinished loops through the column.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-yaldevi: Yaldevi holds clean copy, an e opening rightward, outsized lowercase throughout. Chubbo does contrast-free marker bends best, while Yaldevi holds that rightward e through a column.
gen-fs-comico-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Poured-lead lowercase, words spread wide, a couple of lines: Comico over Be Vietnam Pro. Be Vietnam Pro holds a steel-rod sans-serif line, and that spaced display plus open copy is the lock.
gen-fs-comico-fs-epilogue: Whimsical Comico pours lead-like lowercase, tracking spread, a short burst only. Epilogue brings unclamped wire against that spaced display, and that is the quality that holds the sans-serif pair.
gen-fs-erode-poppins: Poppins stays modern, no thick-thin flicker, rope-loose curves, sturdy lowercase under crisp Erode on the sheet. The heading wants a few huge words, nothing more here.
gen-fs-erode-rubik: Rubik holds clean copy, lowercase looking big next to capitals, open rounds that stay clear at small sizes under Erode. The heading wants a few huge words only.
